icons.label: Go
icons.use_for: Playing or learning Go, baduk, or weiqi, including clubs with indirect names.
icons.avoid_for: Unrelated uses of go; a film, lecture, or mixed game list where Go is not primary.

icons.label: Dominoes
icons.use_for: Playing or learning dominoes.
icons.avoid_for: Domino-brand venues, domino-effect talks, unrelated games.

icons.label: Scrabble
icons.use_for: Scrabble play, lessons, or tournaments.
icons.avoid_for: Generic word games or a mixed-game event without a primary game.

icons.label: Magic: The Gathering
icons.use_for: Magic: The Gathering play, drafts, Commander, or tournaments.
icons.avoid_for: Stage magic, meeting abbreviations, Pokemon or generic trading-card games.

icons.label: Tabletop role-playing
icons.use_for: Participatory tabletop role-playing, including D&D, Dungeons & Drafts, campaigns and one-shots.
icons.avoid_for: Fantasy films, video games, lectures about RPGs, or beer drafts alone.

icons.label: Trivia
icons.use_for: Trivia games and pub quizzes.
icons.avoid_for: Lectures, general learning, or incidental trivia in an unrelated event.

icons.label: Bingo
icons.use_for: Number-based or other ordinary bingo, including drag bingo.
icons.avoid_for: Music/song identification bingo: prefer music-bingo.

icons.label: Music bingo
icons.use_for: Bingo played by identifying songs, including Music, Musical, and Mixtape Bingo.
icons.avoid_for: Regular bingo with incidental background music; unrelated mixtape performances.

icons.label: Machine sewing
icons.use_for: Sewing-machine classes or activities where machine sewing is central.
icons.avoid_for: Hand sewing, knitting, generic fiber arts without machine use.

icons.label: 3D printing
icons.use_for: 3D printing, learning to use 3D printers, or hands-on print fabrication.
icons.avoid_for: 2D printing, 3D films, generic modeling without printing.

icons.label: Backgammon
icons.use_for: Playing or learning backgammon.
icons.avoid_for: Generic board-game events without backgammon as the primary game.

icons.label: Rummikub
icons.use_for: Playing or learning Rummikub.
icons.avoid_for: Card rummy, slots, or generic tile/board games.

icons.label: Pole dance
icons.use_for: Pole dance, pole fitness, and related participatory classes.
icons.avoid_for: Unrelated uses of pole, general dance without a pole.

icons.label: Chair yoga
icons.use_for: Yoga practiced with a chair or explicitly described seated yoga.
icons.avoid_for: General yoga or seated exercise that is not yoga.

icons.label: Glassblowing
icons.use_for: Glassblowing classes, participatory glass shaping with a blowpipe.
icons.avoid_for: Fused/stained glass, generic glass art, or unrelated flame work.

icons.label: Pickleball
icons.use_for: Pickleball play, practice, lessons, leagues and tournaments.
icons.avoid_for: Other paddle/racket sports; mixed sports sessions without primary pickleball.

icons.label: Interlocking toy bricks
icons.use_for: Building with LEGO or similar interlocking toy bricks, including dedicated building clubs and challenges.
icons.avoid_for: Masonry, LEGO films/video games, retail visits, or mixed activities where brick building is incidental.

icons.label: DJ decks
icons.use_for: DJ sets, DJ-led dance parties, open decks, turntablism, or hands-on DJ mixing instruction.
icons.avoid_for: Passive vinyl listening, live instrumental concerts with incidental DJs, broad festivals, background dinner music, or equipment mentioned only in passing.

icons.label: Crochet
icons.use_for: Crochet instruction, practice, dedicated clubs and projects centered on using a crochet hook.
icons.avoid_for: Knitting, machine/hand sewing, yarn displays, or co-primary mixed fiber activities with no crochet focus.

icons.label: Trombone
icons.use_for: Trombone lessons, recitals, or concerts where an explicitly identified trombonist or trombone ensemble is the featured musical focus.
icons.avoid_for: Trumpet, film plots, generic jazz, or one trombone section among a larger mixed ensemble.

icons.label: Steelpan
icons.use_for: Steelpan/steel-drum performances, lessons or participatory sessions where the tuned instrument is central.
icons.avoid_for: Oil drums, skin drums, generic Caribbean music or incidental percussion.

icons.label: Kalimba
icons.use_for: Kalimba/thumb-piano performances and lessons where the instrument is central.
icons.avoid_for: Keyboard piano, generic folk jams listing kalimba as one optional activity, or unspecified percussion.

icons.label: Guzheng
icons.use_for: Guzheng performances, recitals and workshops where the Chinese plucked zither is central.
icons.avoid_for: Harp, guqin, koto, keyboard, generic Chinese music, or incidental ensemble instrumentation.

icons.label: Cello
icons.use_for: Cello lessons, recitals, cello-led concerts or ensembles where cello is the central musical focus.
icons.avoid_for: Violin, double bass, theater with cello accompaniment, or mixed ensembles listing cello only as one instrument.

icons.label: Double bass
icons.use_for: Acoustic upright bass/contrabass lessons or performances where the double bass is the central musical focus.
icons.avoid_for: Electric bass guitar, generic bass music, generic jazz, or supporting bass in a mixed ensemble.
